content.title: Strategic Result: Quality of Life
content.summary: The City Council has established strategic goals aimed at enhancing the quality of life for residents by 2030, focusing on safety, community engagement, resilience, and equitable access to resources. As of July 1, 2024, the City Team will monitor progress on these goals, with updates provided quarterly, starting in October. Key objectives include fostering a safe community, adapting to changing needs, and ensuring exceptional customer service while preserving the natural environment for future generations.
content.body:
Below are the City Council's Strategic Goals related to Quality of Life to be achieved between now and 2030. As of July 1, 2024, the City Team has begun monitoring these internal goals. Over the next quarter, progress on these internal actions and goals will be measured to support the achievement of the City Council's strategic direction. The first progress update will be provided here in October, with subsequent updates occurring quarterly. You will soon be able to access detailed information about the internal goals, actions, and measures being monitored and reported on by the City Team to ensure the implementation of the City Council’s strategic vision. [View the City Council Strategic Plan](/DocumentCenter/View/4218/COA-Council-Strat-Plan-2024-ADA---facing-pages-1).

**![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4201)Strategic Result:** Foster an accessible and inclusive community that preserves and improves quality of life and ensures a safe and thriving place for all community members.

---

## Strategic Goal 1

Create a safe community for all to enjoy through education, neighborhood connection, and engagement while also ensuring compliance with laws and ordinances.

## Strategic Goal 2

Take care of our community by continually improving and adapting to the changing needs of our community members and environment.

## Strategic Goal 3

Strengthen community resilience and well-being by proactively collaborating in emergency management initiatives, ensuring preparedness, effective response, and swift recovery.

## Strategic Goal 4

Prioritize policies, practices, and projects for development that protect and sustain a high quality of life for residents and businesses.

## Strategic Goal 5

Provide equitable access to the natural environment citywide and preserve these amenities for future generations.

## Strategic Goal 6

Engage the community in meaningful opportunities to share their perspectives and values on decisions that affect them.

## Strategic Goal 7

Provide exceptional customer service to all residents, businesses, and visitors of the City.
